added.summary: Text on a path (CSS -og-text-path in documents, SVG 2 textPath layout): path("<SVG path data>") or circle([r]), -og-text-path-offset in px or % of the path, text-align as the anchor, -og-text-path-side: right to run it backwards. Each grapheme is turned to the path with its baseline on it; what runs off an open path is dropped and a circle wraps. An element with no size is as large as its path. CSS offset-path still moves the element itself.
